caption: Usage Observation
description: One reported token-usage observation, in disjoint economic tranches: uncached input, cache reads and cache writes (with their tiers), and output with its reasoning part. Scope, aggregation and finality are separate facets; components are present only when reported or exactly derived (components[] says which); absence is not zero. data keeps the native usage object exactly.
name: usage_observation

scope_id.description: The scope at which the source reported this observation. At 99 Other the unit, named in scope, is the enclosing event's own item: its item_uid (or tool_call_uid) in the namespace that event's identity_basis_id states, within the observation's source artifact.

basis.description: The declared rules that established usage_status_id and aggregation_id.

data.description: The native usage object exactly as reported.
